title: Figure 2: Schematic of the 1995 Ghost Interference experiment (Shih group)
description: Optical schematic showing an "Ar Laser" emitting 351 nm light through a "BBO" crystal and "UV Prism," then a beam splitter (BS) separating "e" and "o" photons; one path passes through "Slits" and filter f1 to detector D1, the other through filter f2 at position X2 via "fiber" to D2. Both detectors feed a "Gated N2" counter with a "Gating" line. The caption reads "Figure 2. Schematic of the 1995 Ghost Interference Experiment (Reference 16) of the Shih group."
